name: Lattice Drone
method: Direct visual review of all four references; file checks do not verify shared mechanical topology.
confirmed: Six radial vanes and hexagonal dark frame retained in front/rear.
Single front tracking lens, opaque rear cap, spherical violet lattice core.
Profiles point lens in opposite directions and narrow the frame.
limitations: Right profile adds visible diagonal fin tips absent on left; inconsistent edge-on projection must be corrected.
Six vane roots cannot all be traced in profiles; define fixed coplanar frame and vane geometry.
Lens remains oblique rather than exactly edge-on.
Lattice band routes change across views; establish shared core structure.
Frame/core thickness and top/bottom vane dimensions need normalization.
Tips close to canvas edge require animation padding.
next: Correct lateral vane projection and fixed frame geometry, separate lens/core/frame/vanes, then author tracking aim, hover, firing and breakup with separate beam VFX.
